changelog:
• Keamanan Tingkat Kernel C++: Integrasi NativeSigner via Direct Linux Syscall, proteksi anti-debugging TracerPid & maps injection, serta volatile memory zeroization pada setiap signature API.
• Remote TV Responsif di Mode Bersih: Tombol remote (OK, D-Pad, Play/Pause) langsung ditangkap di level Activity sehingga navbar selalu muncul.
• List Episode & Auto-Scroll: Drawer episode otomatis scroll ke nomor episode aktif dan fokus navigasi remote stabil tanpa freeze.
• Pemutaran Video Stabil (Anti-Freeze): Optimasi alokasi single-player hardware MediaCodec TV sehingga video dan audio tetap sinkron tanpa freeze gambar.
